notes.title: Get Over Here has been updated!
notes.content:
There is a new update fro get Over Here!

There are many new fixes in this build:

- Now the item No-Hook will last 10 seconds. Before it was until someone gets killed.

- Fixed an issue with the Sudden Death. 

- Fixed the tie on the tournament. Now it is working as intended.

- Fixed the way the game detects the controller, now it supports more different controllers.

- Now to add a new player to the game the player must press a button during the character selection interface.
